name: MoeMail
tagline: MoeMail is a free, open-source temporary email service built on Next.js and Cloudflare (Workers, D1, Email Routing)
description: MoeMail is a free, open-source temporary email service built on Next.js and Cloudflare (Workers, D1, Email Routing). What it does - Create a disposable inbox in one click and receive mail in real time - Mailbox lifetimes of 1 hour, 24 hours, 3 days or permanent; expired mail is cleaned up automatically - Share a single email or a whole inbox with a link For developers - Webhook notifications when new mail arrives - Public OpenAPI so test suites and AI agents can create mailboxes and read message
